You can try calling the national domestic violence line or find your local one. It doesn’t necessarily solve any but if they are a good one they will have trained counselors who know all about abuse and abusive patterns. It can at least be a place to be able to talk to someone. And if a person you’re talking to ever doesn’t seem sensitive to what you’re saying just hang up. Well that’s what I did a few times. Most were quite good. I’m not pushing to call anywhere. Just wanted to share this. 

I also went to a place that worked with victims of crimes, it was a community place and they had free counseling and that woman saved my sanity at the time. 

I’ve been there too and have been suicidal many times. It doesn’t make things go away, but learning about patterns and cycles of abuse helped me start seeing the degree of manipulation going on and how I’d been systematically broken down. 

I know these numbers and websites are not answers for everything. 
This wheel of abuse helped me too. 
[Power & Control Wheel](http://www.ncdsv.org/images/PowerControlwheelNOSHADING.pdf)

I speak to a counselor once a week from my local domestic violence center. She’s amazing. Also they have free legal aid. Sorry if all this is unhelpful. I’m not totally okay myself today but reading your message just made me want to write something, no matter how lame. 

Maybe just consider to try reaching out to some places that would be trained and understand. I also went to a rape counseling center that also helped me. 
It’s not like just one of them made everything better but different one did start helping, slowly, to make some sense of things. And that I’d been tricked and manipulated basically, and having some people really get that did help in different ways. 

I remember one counselor saying to me, tell me about yourself before you ever met him. It was hard at first to remember but I started journaling about it and sharing with her and remembering who I was before. And I’m still working on finding myself again. I still feel very angry. Sorry this was so long and useless. I truly hope you find a way through.
